    Methods in org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.federation.policies.manager with parameters of type FederationPolicyInitializationContext
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    FederationAMRMProxyPolicy
    AbstractPolicyManager.getAMRMPolicy(FederationPolicyInitializationContext federationPolicyContext, FederationAMRMProxyPolicy oldInstance)
    This default implementation validates the FederationPolicyInitializationContext, then checks whether it needs to reinstantiate the class (null or mismatching type), and reinitialize the policy.
    FederationAMRMProxyPolicy
    FederationPolicyManager.getAMRMPolicy(FederationPolicyInitializationContext policyContext, FederationAMRMProxyPolicy oldInstance)
    If the current instance is compatible, this method returns the same instance of FederationAMRMProxyPolicy reinitialized with the current context, otherwise a new instance initialized with the current context is provided.
    FederationRouterPolicy
    AbstractPolicyManager.getRouterPolicy(FederationPolicyInitializationContext federationPolicyContext, FederationRouterPolicy oldInstance)
    This default implementation validates the FederationPolicyInitializationContext, then checks whether it needs to reinstantiate the class (null or mismatching type), and reinitialize the policy.
    FederationRouterPolicy
    FederationPolicyManager.getRouterPolicy(FederationPolicyInitializationContext policyContext, FederationRouterPolicy oldInstance)
    If the current instance is compatible, this method returns the same instance of FederationRouterPolicy reinitialized with the current context, otherwise a new instance initialized with the current context is provided.
